what: Effective-n / power gate for the DATA/DEEP within-deep eval route -- the e-0045 analogue on the pivoted-to corpus. Composes the within-deep module-disjoint eval split (e-0031) x deep substantive-frontier construct validity (e-0032) x per-area round-trip yield (e-0028) to get the number of eval problems that are BOTH granularity-bearing AND verified -- the effective n for the granularity effect -- then feeds it through e-0040's McNemar/Gaussian-copula MDE machinery (unchanged).

effective_n.note: effective n = expected VERIFIED granularity-bearing eval problems (yield-weighted). corpus_v3 analogue (e-0045): 5.

mde.note: smallest absolute rough-fine pass@1 gap reaching 80% power at the deep effective n, per weaker-policy rate p_lo.

caveats: Verified counts are the e-0028 per-area PROJECTION, not an actual round-trip (needs the Modal pass). Module-disjoint is the standard but not airtight leakage control (e-0031). Construct = substantive-frontier PRESENCE (inline-able have), not the term-vs-tactic FORMAT confound, which the same-format build (e-0033) removes by construction. Projects COUNTS not pass@k; MDE is a design-stage calc on marginals/rho the user still picks; the gap x model-SIZE interaction (the true headline) needs MORE power than this single-comparison MDE, so it is a LOWER bound.
interpretation: The within-deep module-disjoint eval holdout (e-0031) carves 131 eval targets, of which 130 (99%) are granularity-bearing (>=1 substantive named have) and 120 (92%) have a >=2 frontier -- the inverse of corpus_v3's 8% (e-0045). After discounting by e-0028 per-area round-trip yield, the effective n for the granularity effect is ~115 verified-AND-granularity-bearing eval problems (>=2 frontier: ~106), vs corpus_v3's 5. McNemar's exact test needs >=6 same-direction discordant pairs to reach alpha=0.05; with a discordant ceiling of ~115 the deep route CAN reject (power > 0), where corpus_v3's ceiling of 5 < 6 gave power exactly 0. At this effective n the detectable absolute rough-fine pass@1 gap is 0.05->0.11, 0.1->0.13, 0.2->0.15 (p_lo->MDE). So e-0045's recommendation is QUANTIFIED: the data/deep route turns the granularity effect from un-resolvable (power 0) into resolvable at a single-comparison MDE comparable to the e-0040 n=116 column -- the within-deep eval is the construct-valid AND adequately-powered path for q-0007's headline that corpus_v3 cannot provide. The interaction (gap x size) still needs the larger DiD power budget (e-0041/e-0043).
